name: The Social Billboard
what: Algorithm free YouTube playlists for children 3 to 16: the parent sets the shape of the session (age band, calm or energetic, educational or entertainment, time of day, length) before the child presses play. No up next, no autoplay; when the playlist ends, it ends.
audience: UK parents of children 3 to 12 who use YouTube and dislike the feed
visual_system: Social Billboard brand.md: near black #0A0A0A, accent #FFD100 (text on gold always #0A0A0A), Montserrat 800 headings, sentence case; tools/tsb-playlist-card for the look

hook.line: Free on one playlist. No card.

hook_status: Taken word for word from the live landing page's own button and closing line (thesocialbillboard.com/safe-youtube-for-kids, read 12 November 2026), so the advert and the page say the same thing. The page confirms the free plan: one playlist of at least five videos, one child profile, the discovery playlists, no card.
counting: NOT BUILT. The site is run by the developer; there is no per link count of sign ups yet. Until there is, judge on Meta's landing page views and cost per landing page view, and say so in every verdict.
judge_on: landing page views per thousand reached, until sign ups per link can be counted

extra_banned.why: say age banded; appropriate is a judgement needing a published framework (Social Billboard rule 4)
no numeric scores or ratings anywhere (YouTube API terms, two violations already)
a credential claim with no named expert (CAP Code 3.7; open question)
YouTube embeds can show pre roll; say no adverts sold by us, or nothing
it is a website, not a device lock

funnel_note: No www: https://www.thesocialbillboard.com fails to connect (checked 12 November 2026); only the bare domain loads.
screens: tools/tsb-playlist-card/shots: real product screens (criteria pickers, the playlist). Never the playlist screens with other creators' thumbnails in an advert.
